bullets.text: A woman on a bike faced sexual harassment in Ambattur as a youth chased and molested her, and the office should monitor police action.
Sathiyam News published a shorts video gathering public opinion on the Pallikaranai marshland, and the constituency team should review public sentiments.
CloudPe launched its new cloud region IN-NORTH1 at Yotta's Tier IV data center in Noida, and the portfolio team should track infrastructure growth.
Sun News reported concerns about the drug mafia in Madhavaram following heroin seizures, and the office should watch political developments regarding this.
